title: Intensity Gains, Scale Effects: Causal Inference and Emissions Impact of Brazil's National Biofuels Policy — replication package
description: Pacote de replicacao do manuscrito submetido a Ecological Economics. Avaliacao causal dos efeitos do programa RenovaBio sobre emissoes AFOLU municipais no Centro-Sul brasileiro (2015-2024), com decomposicao entre ganhos de intensidade produtiva e efeitos de escala, via estimador Callaway-Sant'Anna doubly robust (CS-DR).
notes: This study was financed, in part, by the Sao Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP), Brazil. Process Number #2025/01530-0.
